result.brief: 提出 MultiWorldBench，一个诊断多玩家世界模型共享世界一致性的 Minecraft 基准，覆盖独立控制、跨视角运动、状态同步与持久性等十项能力。
result.reason: Benchmark for multiplayer world models testing shared-world consistency across independently controlled views; directly evaluates video/multimodal world models and their persistent world representation.
